cards.audioText: ACA587, no speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Roger, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，加航587。

cards.audioText: [You executed missed approach procedure and try to land on runway 36R. State this situation to Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【执行复飞程序，尝试降落在跑道36右。向塔台报告该情况。】
cards.referenceText: Tower, ACA587, going around and we try to land runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 塔台，加航587，复飞，我们试降跑道36右。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Control, climb and maintain 5100m, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉区调，上升保持5100米，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 5100m, no speed restriction, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持5100米，没有速度限制，法航123。

cards.audioText: [During the climb, your port engine separated, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【爬升过程中，左侧发动机分离，告诉管制员这一情况，以及你想返回着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Wuhan Control, AFR123, our left engine falls, request to return to the airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, 武汉区调，法航123，飞机左侧发动机脱落，请求返回机场。

cards.audioText: AFR971, runway inspection in progress at the moment, expect delay more than 15min.[Read back the ATC instructions, report that you are entering the hold and hold no more than 15min.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，正在测试跑道，预计延误15分钟以上。【复诵ATC的指令并报告其你已经进入等待点，等待不超过15分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Approach, AFR971, entering the holding pattern, and hold no more than 15min,
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，法航971，我已进入等待程序，等待不能超过15分钟。

cards.audioText: [The EGT of your starboard engine is fluctuating, state this situation to the controller. Ask to leave the holding pattern right away.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机右侧发动机的排气温度不稳定，把这一情况报告给管制员。请求立刻离开等待航线。】
cards.referenceText: Approach, AFR971, The EGT of the right engine is fluctuating, request leave the holding pattern now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，法航971。右侧发动机的排气温度不稳定，请求现在离开等待程序。

cards.audioText: BAW951, Wuhan Ground, pushback and start-up approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，武汉地面，同意推出开车，头朝北。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, facing north, BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，头朝北，英航951。

cards.audioText: [Now you have a problem. One of your passengers is seriously ill. You inform ATC and request to disembark the passenger. You have to delay the pushback due to disembarking the passenger.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你遇到个问题。机上一名乘客生病严重。你通知ATC，请求让该乘客下飞机。由于该乘客离机，你不得不延误推出。】
cards.referenceText: Ground, BAW951, request delay push back and startup, we will disembark the ill passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，英航951，请求推迟推出开车，我们要让生病乘客离机。

cards.audioText: [This time, contact your company to inform this situation. And also, request medical assistance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系公司，报告该情况。同时请求医疗援助。】
cards.referenceText: Dispatch, BAW951, request disembark, and request an ambulance due a passenger seriously ill.
cards.referenceTextZh: 签派，英航951，由于一名乘客生病严重，请求让其下机，并提供一辆救护车。

cards.audioText: CCA987, read back correct, expect slot time 20 due to temporary departure restriction. Report when ready for pushback and start-up.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，复诵正确，根据临时离场限制，预计离场时间20分。准备好推出开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: Report ready for pushback and start-up, CCA987.
cards.referenceTextZh: 准备好推出开车时报告，国航987。

cards.audioText: [Tell the controller that there are two passengers missing, and the bags have already removed from the aircraft. The load sheet is amended. Contact the controller to report the situation and state you are ready for push.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉管制员机上两名乘客没来，他们的行李已卸下。舱单已经修订。联系管制员报告该情况，并说明你已准备好推出。】
cards.referenceText: Ground, CCA987, two passengers missing and bags are removed, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，国航987，2名乘客没来，行李已经卸下，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CES586, turn right heading 330, descend and maintain 900m ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，右转航向330，下降保持900米，盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 900m, turn right heading 330, ILS approach runway 36R, CES586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，右转航向330，盲降进近跑道36右，东方586。

cards.audioText: [While intercepting the localizer, the drunk passenger discharges the fire extinguisher. The purser make an emergency call said there is still passenger standing in the cabin. Inform the Wuhan Approach the situation and request terminate the approach, proceed to the holding area.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【切入航道时，该醉酒乘客打开灭火器。接到乘务长的紧急呼叫，说仍有乘客站在客舱里。通知武汉进近该情况，请求中止进近，继续进入等待区。】
cards.referenceText: Approach, CES586, Terminate the approach and request hold due passenger discharges the fire extinguisher and some passengers standing in the cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，东方586，中止进近，一名乘客打开灭火器，还有一些乘客站在客舱里，请求中止进近并等待。

cards.audioText: SIA151, deviation 10nm to the left approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，可以向左偏10海里。
cards.referenceText: Deviation 10nm to the left. SIA151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向左偏10海里。新航151。

cards.audioText: [The purser report there is strange smell coming from the rear cabin. Tell ATC this situation and request further descent as a precaution.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【乘务长报告称后舱内传出异味。告诉ATC该情况，同时请求进一步下降作为预防措施。】
cards.referenceText: Hong Kong Control, SIA151, there is strange smell from our rear cabin, request descent as a precaution.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港区调，新航151，飞机后舱有异味，请求下降作为预防。

cards.audioText: SIA854, intersection departure from E2 approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2. Hold short of runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，可以在滑行道E2进跑道起飞。沿滑行道A6, A, A2滑行至滑行道E2，在跑道18左外等待。
cards.referenceText: Intersection departure from E2 approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2. Hold short of runway 18L, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以从滑行道E2进跑道起飞。沿滑行道A6，A，A2滑至滑行道E2，在跑道18左外等待，新航854。

cards.audioText: [During taxiing, you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about this situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【滑行中，你发现滑行道A上有一抛锚车辆，你停下飞机，通知ATC该情况，请求机场服务拖走该车辆。】
cards.referenceText: Ground, SIA854, there is a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, we stopped the aircraft, request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，新航854，滑行道A上有一抛锚车辆，我们停下飞机，请求机场服务拖走该车辆。

cards.audioText: UAL239, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 9200m, expedite descend until passing 9800m due crossing traffic.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，武汉区调，雷达已识别，下降保持9200米，由于交叉活动，快速下降通过9800米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9200m, expedite descent until passing 9800m, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持9200米，由于交叉活动，快速下降通过9800米，美联航239。

cards.audioText: [You are now maintaining 9200m. You are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence (CAT). Inform ATC of this situation and request further descend and maintain 8400m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞行高度9200米保持。你正在经历中度晴空乱流。通知ATC该情况并请求进一步下降8400米保持。】
cards.referenceText: Control, UAL239, maintaining 9200m. Request further descent to 8400m due moderate clear air turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 区调，美联航239，9200米保持。由于晴空乱流，请求进一步下降8400米。

cards.audioText: AFR872, Wuhan Approach, what is the situation on board now? Keep us advised.[You are grateful for the reminding, report to ATC that more smoke accumulated in the passenger cabin and the passengers are coughing hard.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航872，武汉进近，现在机上情况怎么样？随时报告。【感谢ATC的提醒，报告客舱内烟雾越来越多，乘客们咳嗽的很严重。】
cards.referenceText: Thanks. The smoke is becoming denser in the passenger cabin and the passengers are coughing hard, AFR872.
cards.referenceTextZh: 谢谢，客舱内的烟雾越来越浓，乘客们咳嗽的很严重，法航872。

cards.audioText: BAW038, report current situation.[Tell the controller that the port engine flamed out and you should land as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，报告现在的情况。【告诉管制员左发熄火了，你需要尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Port engine flames out, request priority landing, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左发动机熄火，请求优先着陆，英航038。

cards.audioText: JAL220, change to runway 36R is approved, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, you are number one.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，同意变更到跑道36右，在600米保持，右转飞至WHA，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, number one for landing, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36右，在600米保持，右转飞至WHA，第一个落地，日航220。

cards.audioText: After landing, you find your APU has failed, tell this situation to Wuhan Tower and ask for Ground Power Unit.
cards.audioTextZh: 落地后，你发现你的APU失效了，将情况告知武汉塔台，请求地面电力设备。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, JAL220, request ground power unit due APU failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，由于APU失效，请求地面电力设备。

cards.audioText: CCA991, Beijing Control. Report situation.[Tell the controller that you suspect something is on fire, you try to find the exact location of the fire, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，北京区调。报告情况。【告诉管制员你怀疑机上起火，你试图找出起火的准确位置，请求返回北京机场并优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: We suspect something is on fire, we are trying to locate the source now, Request return to Beijing airport and priority landing, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 疑似起火，我们正在定位火源，请求返回北京机场优先着陆，国航991。

cards.audioText: CSN586, taxi with caution, men and equipment operating east of taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，谨慎滑行，滑行道A东部有人和设备运行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks. Taxi with caution. CSN586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，谨慎滑行，南方586。

cards.audioText: [You encountered the wind shear between 200m to 400m, report the situation to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你在200米到400米之间遇到了风切变，向管制员报告此情况]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN586, we encountered wind shear between 200m to 400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方586，在200米到400米之间遇到了风切变。

cards.audioText: QFA683, taxi via F, C1 and B to holding point runway 26. Caution work in progress at the end of gate 319.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航683，经由F，C1和B，滑行至跑道26等待点，注意，319号机坪尽头有施工。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via F, C1, B to holding point runway 26, thanks for caution, QFA683.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由F，C1和B，滑行至跑道26等待点，谢谢提醒，澳航683。

cards.audioText: [As you are taxiing, you notice some smoke coming from APU on B747 ahead of you, report this to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你在滑行时，你注意到前方B747的APU冒出烟雾，将此报告给管制员]
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA683, some smoke coming from the APU of the B747 ahead of us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，澳航683，我前方B747的APU冒出烟雾。

cards.audioText: SIA497, radar contact, turn left direct to DA, climb to 3000m, QNH1021.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航497，雷达识别，左转直飞DA，爬升至3000米，修正海压1021。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb to 3000m, QNH1021, SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，爬升至3000米，修正海压1021，新航497。

cards.audioText: [When you are approaching Singapore airport, your landing gears cannot be extended normally. Report this situation to Singapore airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你接近新加坡机场，你的起落架无法正常放下，将此情况报告给新加坡机场。]
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA497, we can't extend the landing gears normally.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航497，我们无法正常放下起落架。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, climb to 2700m on QNH 1008.
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2700m on QNH 1008, CSN9302.

cards.audioText: B: [During climb, suddenly you’ve been struck by a foreign object, possibly hail strike. Your instruments are indicating incorrectly. Report this situation to Guangzhou Approach and request return to land.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【在爬升过程中，你突然遭遇外物撞击，可能是冰雹。仪表显示异常。向广州进近报告此情况，请求返航着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN9302, we’ve been struck by a foreign object, possibly hail strike, our instruments are indicating incorrectly, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，南方9302，我们被外物撞击，可能是冰雹，仪表显示异常，请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3112, orbit right from present position until advised of the weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 南方3112，从现在位置向右盘旋等待，前方天气情况稍后告知。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right from present position until advised, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从现在位置向右盘旋等待直到告知，南方3112。

cards.audioText: B: [After several orbits, you find you don’t have enough fuel to hold any further. Report this situation to Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【经过多次盘旋，你发现你没有足够的燃油继续等待。将情况报告给北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN3112, we don’t have enough fuel to hold any further.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方3112，我们没有足够的燃油继续等待。

cards.audioText: [During climb, you found your generators have failed, and you are flying with aircraft battery, report this situation to Shanghai Departure, tell them you need to return.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在爬升过程中，你发现你的发电机故障了，现在靠电池供电，报告该情况，并请求返场。]
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Shanghai Departure, KLM88, we are flying with aircraft battery, our generators failed, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，上海离场，荷航88，发电机故障了，现在靠电池供电，请求返场。

cards.audioText: [You are now at 3600m, you smell something unusual in the cockpit, but you haven’t found out the source of the smell, report this situation to Wuhan Tower and request to hold for doing the checklist.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在3600米，你在驾驶舱内闻到异常气味，但是你没有发现气味来源，将情况报告给武汉塔台，申请等待并执行检查单。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR332, 3600m, we find unusual smell in the cockpit, but we haven’t found out the source, request to hold for checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航332, 3600米，我们在驾驶舱发现异常气味，但是我们还没有发现气味来源，请求等待并执行检查单。

cards.audioText: [As you are climbing, you notice a large unmanned balloon. Your position is 4 miles north of the airfield and current height is 2000 meters. Report this to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你爬升时，你注意到一个大型无人气球，你的位置是机场以北4海里，当前高度2000米，将此报告给管制员。]
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Departure, CSN582, we have seen a large unmanned balloon. Our position is 4 miles north of the airfield and current height is 2000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都离场，南方582，我们看到一个大型无人气球，我们位置是机场以北4海里，当前高度2000米。

cards.audioText:
AFR754, 20 miles deviate west is approved.
[During cruise, you find that the navigation performance has been downgraded, report this to ATC and ask them to verify your flight track.]
cards.audioTextZh:
法航754，同意西偏航20海里。
[在巡航过程中，你发现导航性能降级，向管制员报告，请他们核实你的飞行轨迹。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR754, our navigation performance down-graded, request verify our flight track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航754，我们的导航性能降级，请求核实我们的飞行轨迹。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, QFA432.
N: You were cleared to 1200m but notice the sky is turning yellow color and visibility is deteriorating quickly. You suspect a sandstorm. Tell Beijing Approach this and ask ATC if there is a sand storm forecast.
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，澳航432。
你被许可到1200米，但是你注意到天空变黄，能见度快速变差。你怀疑是沙尘暴。告知北京进近，询问管制员是否有沙暴预报。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, maintaining 1200 meters, the sky is turning yellow and the visibility is getting worse. Confirm if there is a sandstorm forecast.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，澳航432，在1200米保持，天空变黄，能见度变差，证实是否有沙尘暴预报。

cards.audioText: N: The sandstorm is very severe and visibility is now very poor. Inform ATC of the situation and ask to climb to higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: 沙尘暴很严重，能见度很低。通知管制员该情况，请求爬升到更高的高度以飞越沙尘暴。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, the sandstorm is very severe and visibility is now very poor, request climb to higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，澳航432，沙尘暴非常严重，现在能见度很低，请求爬升到更高高度以飞越沙尘暴。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN1310, roger, fire trucks and stair vehicles have been sent. Report current situation.
[The fuel leak has stopped, but you still need some ground assistance to deal with the fuel on the runway.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 南方1310，收到，消防车和客梯车已经出动。报告当前情况。
【燃油泄漏已经停止，但你仍然需要一些地面协助来处理跑道上的燃油。】
cards.referenceText: The fuel leak has stopped, but we still need some ground assistance to deal with the fuel on the runway, CSN1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 燃油泄漏已经停止，但是我们仍然需要一些地面协助来处理跑道上的燃油，南方1310。

cards.audioText: B: [The passenger took out the overhead oxygen mask. He is being closely monitored. Report the situation to the controller and request descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【该乘客拿出头顶上的氧气面罩。他被密切地监测。报告管制员该情况并请求下降。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES556, request descent. The passenger took out the oxygen mask and being monitored.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方556，请求下降。该乘客拿出氧气面罩，他已被监控起来。
